panels.title: Tutorial finished
panels.description: Share of the new saves that completed every act 1 tutorial goal.

targets.rawSql:
WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT save_id FROM events
  WHERE name = 'save_opened' AND props->>'kind' = 'new' AND save_id IS NOT NULL AND game = 'driftworks' AND ('ALL' IN (${version:sqlstring}) OR version IN (${version:sqlstring})) AND ('ALL' IN (${platform:sqlstring}) OR platform IN (${platform:sqlstring})) AND $__timeFilter(at)
), top AS (
  SELECT c.save_id, coalesce(max((e.props->>'goal_index')::int), -1) AS top
  FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN events e ON e.save_id = c.save_id AND e.name = 'goal_completed'
  GROUP BY c.save_id
)
SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE top >= 6) / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) AS "%" FROM top

SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY mins) AS "Minutes"
FROM (SELECT install_id, sum(mins) AS mins FROM (
  SELECT install_id, session_id, extract(epoch FROM max(at) - min(at)) / 60 AS mins FROM events WHERE game = 'driftworks' AND ('ALL' IN (${version:sqlstring}) OR version IN (${version:sqlstring})) AND ('ALL' IN (${platform:sqlstring}) OR platform IN (${platform:sqlstring})) AND $__timeFilter(at) GROUP BY 1, 2
) s GROUP BY install_id) p

panels.title: Goal funnel
panels.description: New saves started in the time range, and how many of them completed each goal by now. Goals complete in order. A1, A2, A3 are the acts.

targets.rawSql:
WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT save_id FROM events
  WHERE name = 'save_opened' AND props->>'kind' = 'new' AND save_id IS NOT NULL AND game = 'driftworks' AND ('ALL' IN (${version:sqlstring}) OR version IN (${version:sqlstring})) AND ('ALL' IN (${platform:sqlstring}) OR platform IN (${platform:sqlstring})) AND $__timeFilter(at)
), top AS (
  SELECT c.save_id, coalesce(max((e.props->>'goal_index')::int), -1) AS top
  FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN events e ON e.save_id = c.save_id AND e.name = 'goal_completed'
  GROUP BY c.save_id
), goals(i, label) AS (VALUES (-1, '00 Started'), (0, '01 A1 Mine ore and sell it'), (1, '02 A1 Carry goods with the Kite'), (2, '03 A1 Research Cargo racks I'), (3, '04 A1 Build your first ship'), (4, '05 A1 Complete a contract'), (5, '06 A1 Research Fleet licence I'), (6, '07 A1 Refit a ship with bigger cargo racks'), (7, '08 A1 Research Order queue I'), (8, '09 A1 Run a fleet of six ships'), (9, '10 A1 Earn 100,000 credits in total'), (10, '11 A1 Research the warp drive'), (11, '12 A2 Build a scout'), (12, '13 A2 Survey a system'), (13, '14 A2 Sell goods in another system'), (14, '15 A2 Survey five systems'), (15, '16 A2 Become Friendly with a second faction'), (16, '17 A2 Earn 2,500,000 credits in total'), (17, '18 A2 Sell steel or glass'), (18, '19 A2 Run a fleet of twelve ships'), (19, '20 A2 Research your first hazard shielding'), (20, '21 A3 Survey a system with a hazard'), (21, '22 A3 Hire a commander'), (22, '23 A3 Send a fleet on a mission'), (23, '24 A3 Sell circuits or hull plating'), (24, '25 A3 Salvage a derelict'), (25, '26 A3 Survey 100 systems'), (26, '27 A3 Raise a commander to level 3'), (27, '28 A3 Research Station blueprints'), (28, '29 All done'))
SELECT g.label AS "Goal", (SELECT count(*) FROM top WHERE top.top >= g.i) AS "Saves"
FROM goals g WHERE g.i < 28 ORDER BY g.i

panels.title: Stopped playing at
panels.description: Saves started in the time range with no events for 7 days, by the goal they were on when they stopped.

targets.rawSql:
WITH saves AS (
  SELECT save_id, max(at) AS last_at, min(at) AS first_at,
    coalesce(max((props->>'goal_index')::int) FILTER (WHERE name = 'goal_completed'), -1) + 1 AS next
  FROM events WHERE game = 'driftworks' AND ('ALL' IN (${version:sqlstring}) OR version IN (${version:sqlstring})) AND ('ALL' IN (${platform:sqlstring}) OR platform IN (${platform:sqlstring})) AND save_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY save_id
), goals(i, label) AS (VALUES (-1, '00 Started'), (0, '01 A1 Mine ore and sell it'), (1, '02 A1 Carry goods with the Kite'), (2, '03 A1 Research Cargo racks I'), (3, '04 A1 Build your first ship'), (4, '05 A1 Complete a contract'), (5, '06 A1 Research Fleet licence I'), (6, '07 A1 Refit a ship with bigger cargo racks'), (7, '08 A1 Research Order queue I'), (8, '09 A1 Run a fleet of six ships'), (9, '10 A1 Earn 100,000 credits in total'), (10, '11 A1 Research the warp drive'), (11, '12 A2 Build a scout'), (12, '13 A2 Survey a system'), (13, '14 A2 Sell goods in another system'), (14, '15 A2 Survey five systems'), (15, '16 A2 Become Friendly with a second faction'), (16, '17 A2 Earn 2,500,000 credits in total'), (17, '18 A2 Sell steel or glass'), (18, '19 A2 Run a fleet of twelve ships'), (19, '20 A2 Research your first hazard shielding'), (20, '21 A3 Survey a system with a hazard'), (21, '22 A3 Hire a commander'), (22, '23 A3 Send a fleet on a mission'), (23, '24 A3 Sell circuits or hull plating'), (24, '25 A3 Salvage a derelict'), (25, '26 A3 Survey 100 systems'), (26, '27 A3 Raise a commander to level 3'), (27, '28 A3 Research Station blueprints'), (28, '29 All done'))
SELECT g.label AS "Next goal", count(s.save_id) AS "Saves"
FROM goals g LEFT JOIN saves s ON s.next = g.i AND s.last_at < now() - interval '7 days' AND $__timeFilter(s.first_at)
WHERE g.i >= 0
GROUP BY g.i, g.label ORDER BY g.i

panels.title: Goals: reach and time
panels.description: Minutes played counts time with the game on screen on that device. Hours since start is real time since the company was founded. Compare with the balance bots (npm run balance).

targets.rawSql:
WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT save_id FROM events
  WHERE name = 'save_opened' AND props->>'kind' = 'new' AND save_id IS NOT NULL AND game = 'driftworks' AND ('ALL' IN (${version:sqlstring}) OR version IN (${version:sqlstring})) AND ('ALL' IN (${platform:sqlstring}) OR platform IN (${platform:sqlstring})) AND $__timeFilter(at)
), top AS (
  SELECT c.save_id, coalesce(max((e.props->>'goal_index')::int), -1) AS top
  FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN events e ON e.save_id = c.save_id AND e.name = 'goal_completed'
  GROUP BY c.save_id
), goals(i, label) AS (VALUES (-1, '00 Started'), (0, '01 A1 Mine ore and sell it'), (1, '02 A1 Carry goods with the Kite'), (2, '03 A1 Research Cargo racks I'), (3, '04 A1 Build your first ship'), (4, '05 A1 Complete a contract'), (5, '06 A1 Research Fleet licence I'), (6, '07 A1 Refit a ship with bigger cargo racks'), (7, '08 A1 Research Order queue I'), (8, '09 A1 Run a fleet of six ships'), (9, '10 A1 Earn 100,000 credits in total'), (10, '11 A1 Research the warp drive'), (11, '12 A2 Build a scout'), (12, '13 A2 Survey a system'), (13, '14 A2 Sell goods in another system'), (14, '15 A2 Survey five systems'), (15, '16 A2 Become Friendly with a second faction'), (16, '17 A2 Earn 2,500,000 credits in total'), (17, '18 A2 Sell steel or glass'), (18, '19 A2 Run a fleet of twelve ships'), (19, '20 A2 Research your first hazard shielding'), (20, '21 A3 Survey a system with a hazard'), (21, '22 A3 Hire a commander'), (22, '23 A3 Send a fleet on a mission'), (23, '24 A3 Sell circuits or hull plating'), (24, '25 A3 Salvage a derelict'), (25, '26 A3 Survey 100 systems'), (26, '27 A3 Raise a commander to level 3'), (27, '28 A3 Research Station blueprints'), (28, '29 All done')), started AS (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM top), times AS (
  SELECT (e.props->>'goal_index')::int AS i,
    percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (e.props->>'played_min')::numeric) AS played,
    percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (e.props->>'age_h')::numeric) AS age
  FROM events e JOIN cohort c ON c.save_id = e.save_id
  WHERE e.name = 'goal_completed' GROUP BY 1
), skips AS (
  SELECT (props->>'goal_index')::int AS i, count(*) AS n FROM events WHERE name = 'tutorial_skipped' AND game = 'driftworks' AND ('ALL' IN (${version:sqlstring}) OR version IN (${version:sqlstring})) AND ('ALL' IN (${platform:sqlstring}) OR platform IN (${platform:sqlstring})) AND $__timeFilter(at) GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT g.label AS "Goal",
  (SELECT count(*) FROM top WHERE top.top >= g.i) AS "Saves",
  round(100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM top WHERE top.top >= g.i) / nullif((SELECT n FROM started), 0), 1) AS "% of started",
  round(100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM top WHERE top.top >= g.i) / nullif((SELECT count(*) FROM top WHERE top.top >= g.i - 1), 0), 1) AS "% of previous",
  round(t.played::numeric, 1) AS "Median minutes played",
  round(t.age::numeric, 1) AS "Median hours since start",
  coalesce(s.n, 0) AS "Guide skipped here"
FROM goals g LEFT JOIN times t ON t.i = g.i LEFT JOIN skips s ON s.i = g.i
WHERE g.i BETWEEN 0 AND 27
ORDER BY g.i

SELECT 'Act ' || (props->>'act') AS "Act", count(DISTINCT save_id) AS "Saves finished",
  round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (props->>'played_min')::numeric)::numeric / 60, 1) AS "Median hours played",
  round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (props->>'age_h')::numeric)::numeric / 24, 1) AS "Median days since start"
FROM events WHERE name = 'act_completed' AND game = 'driftworks' AND ('ALL' IN (${version:sqlstring}) OR version IN (${version:sqlstring})) AND ('ALL' IN (${platform:sqlstring}) OR platform IN (${platform:sqlstring})) AND $__timeFilter(at)
GROUP BY props->>'act' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Versions
panels.description: Compare a release with the one before it.

targets.rawSql:
WITH saves AS (
  SELECT version, save_id, max((props->>'goal_index')::int) FILTER (WHERE name = 'goal_completed') AS top
  FROM events WHERE game = 'driftworks' AND ('ALL' IN (${version:sqlstring}) OR version IN (${version:sqlstring})) AND ('ALL' IN (${platform:sqlstring}) OR platform IN (${platform:sqlstring})) AND $__timeFilter(at) AND save_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT version AS "Version", count(*) AS "Saves played", round(avg(coalesce(top, -1) + 1), 1) AS "Avg goals done"
FROM saves GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC

SELECT props->>'research_id' AS "Research",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE name = 'research_started') AS "Started",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE name = 'research_completed') AS "Done",
  round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (props->>'played_min')::numeric) FILTER (WHERE name = 'research_completed')::numeric, 0) AS "Median minutes played when done"
FROM events WHERE name IN ('research_started', 'research_completed') AND game = 'driftworks' AND ('ALL' IN (${version:sqlstring}) OR version IN (${version:sqlstring})) AND ('ALL' IN (${platform:sqlstring}) OR platform IN (${platform:sqlstring})) AND $__timeFilter(at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC, 2 DESC

SELECT props->>'hull' AS "Hull", count(*) AS "Built" FROM events WHERE name = 'ship_built' AND game = 'driftworks' AND ('ALL' IN (${version:sqlstring}) OR version IN (${version:sqlstring})) AND ('ALL' IN (${platform:sqlstring}) OR platform IN (${platform:sqlstring})) AND $__timeFilter(at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT name AS "Event", count(*) AS "Times", count(DISTINCT save_id) AS "Saves"
FROM events WHERE name IN ('contract_accepted', 'contract_completed', 'mission_started', 'commander_hired', 'derelict_salvaged', 'ship_salvaged', 'system_surveyed') AND game = 'driftworks' AND ('ALL' IN (${version:sqlstring}) OR version IN (${version:sqlstring})) AND ('ALL' IN (${platform:sqlstring}) OR platform IN (${platform:sqlstring})) AND $__timeFilter(at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Shortcuts found (latest snapshot per save)
panels.description: The tutorial only offers these as tips. Do players find them?

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (save_id) save_id, props FROM events
  WHERE name = 'progress_snapshot' AND game = 'driftworks' AND ('ALL' IN (${version:sqlstring}) OR version IN (${version:sqlstring})) AND ('ALL' IN (${platform:sqlstring}) OR platform IN (${platform:sqlstring})) AND $__timeFilter(at) ORDER BY save_id, at DESC
)
SELECT 'Act ' || (props->>'act') AS "Act", count(*) AS "Saves",
  round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE (props->>'copies')::int > 0) / count(*), 1) AS "Used Copy orders %",
  round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE (props->>'repeats')::int > 0) / count(*), 1) AS "Used Repeat to fill %",
  round(avg((props->>'ships')::numeric), 1) AS "Avg ships"
FROM latest GROUP BY props->>'act' ORDER BY 1

SELECT (props->>'from') || ': ' || (props->>'view') AS "Page", count(*) AS "Opened" FROM events WHERE name = 'menu_view' AND game = 'driftworks' AND ('ALL' IN (${version:sqlstring}) OR version IN (${version:sqlstring})) AND ('ALL' IN (${platform:sqlstring}) OR platform IN (${platform:sqlstring})) AND $__timeFilter(at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT name AS "Event", coalesce(props->>'kind', props->>'choice', props->>'reason', props->>'state', '') AS "Kind", count(*) AS "Times"
FROM events WHERE name IN ('save_created', 'save_opened', 'save_started_over', 'cloud_code_prompt', 'cloud_conflict', 'cloud_sync_failed', 'whats_new_viewed', 'away_report_shown', 'settings_changed') AND game = 'driftworks' AND ('ALL' IN (${version:sqlstring}) OR version IN (${version:sqlstring})) AND ('ALL' IN (${platform:sqlstring}) OR platform IN (${platform:sqlstring})) AND $__timeFilter(at)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 3 DESC

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(at, '1d'), count(DISTINCT session_id) AS "Sessions", count(DISTINCT install_id) AS "Players"
FROM events WHERE game = 'driftworks' AND ('ALL' IN (${version:sqlstring}) OR version IN (${version:sqlstring})) AND ('ALL' IN (${platform:sqlstring}) OR platform IN (${platform:sqlstring})) AND $__timeFilter(at)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
